summary.text: Chaotic branching teeth is one of the top ten catastrophes: eighteen huge snow-white beast teeth forming inside black spirals during a heavenly tribulation.

claims.text: During Fang Yuan’s immortal ascension tribulation, while Giant Sun’s will is forced to protect Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, that will recognizes chaotic branching teeth among the heavenly tribulation.

In air filled with lightning and thunder, eighteen spirals appear, spin faster, and expand. Inside each black spiral a large snow-white beast tooth forms slowly. The eighteen teeth are white as snow, each huge like an ancient tree and over thirty meters tall, waiting to strike.

Chaotic branching teeth is one of the top ten catastrophes, ranked higher than snow war tribulation lightning and with greater might. Giant Sun’s will judges that if all eighteen strike at once, even that will cannot resist, and chooses to destroy them in advance with dragon-shaped wills. Most of those dragon wills fall to wind blades, icy hail, and snow war tribulation lightning on the way; only three spirals are destroyed, and two damaged dragon wills leave spirals that recover.
